system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I’d like some help with canceling or returning everything I bought related to gaming. I recently decided to quit gaming so I can focus more on my studies. Can you help me with this?

I can help with that — first I need to verify your account so I can look up your orders. Please provide either:

- your email address, or  
- your full name (first and last) + ZIP code

Also a couple quick clarifying questions so I handle this exactly how you want:

1) By “everything I bought related to gaming” do you mean: all items across your account that are gaming-related (games, consoles, controllers, accessories, etc.) — both orders that are still pending and orders already delivered?  
2) For returned items (delivered orders), do you want refunds returned to the original payment method or to an existing gift card on your account? (Refunds can only go to the original method or an existing gift card.)
3) For any pending orders we can cancel, the system requires a cancellation reason of either “no longer needed” or “ordered by mistake.” Do you have a preferred reason to use for cancellations?

After you provide your email (or name+ZIP) and answer those questions I’ll look up your account and list the specific pending orders we can cancel and delivered orders we can request returns for. I will not make any changes until you confirm each action.

Sure, my email address is mia.garcia2723@example.com.

To answer your questions:

1. Yes, I’d like to return or cancel all items that are gaming-related, whether they’re pending or already delivered.
2. I’d prefer refunds to go back to my original payment method.
3. For the cancellation reason, “no longer needed” works for me.

Thanks for helping me with this!
